verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in debugging agent. Users can hand it several tasks: automatic root-cause analysis and triage (Autofix), generating a code fix and opening a PR, reviewing code changes in GitHub/GitLab, and answering free-form questions about application telemetry. Sentry Agent can also be assigned Linear issues. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Seer's delegated tasks work well in practice, and deeper first-party detail on scope, limits and controls beyond short doc snippets.
